description: Reads the site's robots.txt and tells, robot by robot (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, DuckAssistBot, Meta, Common Crawl, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended), whether it may read the site, separating robots that read for a person (live) from robots that harvest for training. Returns the corrected robots.txt that lets the live readers in while keeping the site's existing rules, ready to paste. Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants
name: open_robots_txt_to_ai
title: Open robots.txt to AI assistants
